responsibility: This source file implements AArch64 driver-side native CPU detection and option rewriting for -mcpu=native, -mtune=native, and -march=native. It parses /proc/cpuinfo (or GCC_CPUINFO), matches implementer/part/variant data against the CPU tables from aarch64-cores.def, derives feature flags from Linux feature strings using the extension dependency metadata, and returns the rewritten command-line option string that the compiler driver injects for the detected CPU or architecture.
